title: Noise: car trouble at the Sodankylä mast, sounds like a fix
description: Two field engineers chat about their own cars at the Sodankylä fell mast parking. It reads like a workaround (cold, restart, a real site) but it is about cars, not the network. Nothing must be extracted, and nothing must bind to SITE-NF-021.

messages.text: Made it up to the Sodankylä fell mast, but my car would not start again at the parking. -28 this morning.
Classic. Did you plug in the block heater?
No socket at the mast parking. I cranked it three times, nothing.
Never crank more than 10 seconds or you kill the battery. Wait a minute between tries, and turn the headlights on for 30 s first to warm the battery. Works every time on my old Volvo.
Headlight trick worked on the second try! Thanks, owe you a coffee.
Ha, and get winter diesel before you drive up there again.
